name: go9_scale500
hypothesis: 100 iters (Fix D) only reaches 50% vs random. Need 500+ iters with proven Fix D config (window buffer, constant LR, 5 epochs) to reach GnuGo L1 level.
success_criteria: >90% vs random by iter 200, loss continuing to decrease. Kill early if loss plateaus for 100 iters.
notes: Fix D (100 iters) results: loss 3.06, value loss 0.26, 50% vs random, 0/10 vs GnuGo L1. eval_games=20 enabled to track play strength. W&B enabled.
summary: 500 iters completed. Loss decreased from 3.5 (warm start) to 1.60 best. Policy loss 1.44, value loss 0.17. Loss plateaued around 1.75 from iter 150-400, then slight improvement to 1.60. vsRandom not tested (eval_games=0). Run on A5000+Threadripper pod (tuned config: 100 games/iter, nn_batch=8). NOTE: fresh_correct experiment (from scratch with alpha=0.03, c_puct=1.5) reached loss 1.70 at iter 128 — suggesting correct hyperparams matter more than warm-starting.
